title: Spherical Time Interval Extent
description: Spatiotemporal interval coordinates in spherical space with start times and durations.

time.description: Array of interval start times in seconds.

duration.description: Array of interval durations in seconds.

azimuth.description: Array of azimuth angles in degrees in [-180, +180).

elevation.description: Array of elevation angles in degrees in [-90, +90].

radius.description: Array of non-negative radial distances (greater than or equal to 0).

disjoint.description: Indicates whether time intervals at identical spatial coordinates are non-overlapping.

exhaustive.description: Indicates whether time intervals cover the time range without gaps.

min_time.description: Lower bound of the time extent in seconds.

max_time.description: Upper bound of the time extent in seconds.

min_azimuth.description: Lower bound of azimuth angle in degrees.

max_azimuth.description: Upper bound of azimuth angle in degrees.

min_elevation.description: Lower bound of elevation angle in degrees.

max_elevation.description: Upper bound of elevation angle in degrees.
